limitations: Only10minutes real endurance, not24/72hour or production acceptance.
Primary soak has24virtual users sharing a connection pool; separate120s test has24independent pools. Do not equate primary FD count with24physical devices.
Shared execution host and overlapping independent test processes; no dedicated CPU guarantee or production capacity inference.
Production restaurant_work loop is used with synthetic feed.pump; NVR, video decoding, model inference, other background workers and real Telegram are excluded.

Primary load transport contains an admin cookie as well as per-employee Bearer headers; staff endpoints selectBearer, but this run is not a cookie-free authorization proof. Independent-pool follow-up uses only staff Bearer credentials.
Default debounce/120s deadline retained; deterministic occupancy cycles160s occupied/80s empty are test inputs.
Resource observations are bounded samples, not proof of absence of memory leaks. Fixture tick instrumentation also retains599small measurement records.
Deadline latency is persisted timestamp lag during steady soak, not end-to-end phone/Telegram delivery, and not deadline lag during high-concurrency bursts.
History rows were directly inserted resolved synthetic alerts. This measures reading latency only; correct selection/prioritization of unresolved tasks is checked independently by root.
No financial savings or cost forecast claimed. Latency PASS is not asserted because no product SLO was supplied.
